parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of environmental types for the specified company. Environmental types classify the nature of environmental incident records.

parameters.name: filters[active]
parameters.description: If true, returns item(s) with a status of 'active'.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort direction. Use the value to sort ascending, or prefix with a hyphen (e.g. -name) to sort descending.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

id.description: Unique identifier of the environmental type. Use as the environmental_type_id parameter when creating or updating environmental records.

name.description: Translated display name of the environmental type.

active.description: Whether this environmental type is available for selection on environmental records. When false, existing references are preserved but new assignments are prevented.

global.description: Whether this environmental type is a Procore-provided default. Global environmental types cannot be deleted.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this environmental type was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this environmental type was last modified, in ISO 8601 format.

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/incidents/environmental_types?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&filters%5Bactive%5D=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE&filters%5Bid%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bupdated_at%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&sort=SOME_STRING_VALUE", headers=headers)
